our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is a combined claim about comparable leading models, declining gains from further scaling, little durable competitive advantage, and substantial price competition.
The post's last-three-months framing supplies the observation window, ending on publication. This industry state has no standard reporting quarter.
Essentially no moat is part of the asserted state, not a condition that must occur before assessment.
Similar benchmark scores alone do not establish diminishing scaling returns or the absence of durable advantages.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes all four components during the target period, including sustained capability convergence and little durable advantage beyond temporary leadership.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evidence establishes substantial durable differentiation, continuing strong marginal scaling gains, or an absence of substantial price competition. Evidence against only one component may justify a mixed assessment if other components are established.
